author: Wolfgang Goetz, Christian Kanzian, Tobias Jakobs
name: hugin
description: Adds an export storage option that sends selected images to Hugin to be stitched into a panorama and reimports the result.
description-extensive: If you shoot overlapping frames to make a panorama, this add-on hands your selected photos off to the Hugin panorama stitcher with a single click. Once Hugin builds the combined image, it can be pulled straight back into your darktable library. You need the free Hugin panorama software installed for this to work.
